name: Testicular cancer
theme: the curable archetype · surveillance is a spine

meta.title: Testicular cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Testicular germ cell tumors (seminoma and nonseminoma), adult
meta.population: Adults (mostly 15-40) with testicular germ cell tumors - THE CURABLE ARCHETYPE: the disease Einhorn's cisplatin revolution turned from lethal to ~95%+ curable (the PVB original PMID-verified: 74% CR in the first 47 evaluable patients, 1977 - with two cisplatin-FREE decoy papers from the same era documented), and the registry's purest expression of the die-of-treatment-not-disease survivorship logic: when nearly everyone survives the cancer, the late effects of the cure (verified second-malignancy receipts; cardiovascular/ototoxic/neuropathic ledgers) become the decision variables. THE MARKER TRIAD (AFP/hCG/LDH) is a STAGING AXIS - the S-classification, unique in oncology (textbook-grade, marked) - and the AFP RULE routes the router itself: AFP elevation means nonseminoma regardless of what the pathology says (classic rule, memory-grade tagged). SURVEILLANCE IS A SPINE, not a compromise: stage I disease of both histologies is surveillance-first on verified randomized receipts.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the curable archetype. THE ARCHETYPE TIE is property-enforced: both stage-I surveillance cards carry the same survival number - because in a disease this curable, survival cannot discriminate and the real currencies are burden and late effects (die of treatment, not disease). The stage-I receipts are verified: seminoma surveillance-first with single-dose carboplatin as the randomized alternative (TE19/MRC-EORTC, 1,477 patients, PMID-verified - with its near-title decoy documented - and the mature contralateral-cancer arithmetic verified: 2 vs 15); nons…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: Seminoma vs nonseminoma as the router (with the AFP rule at the gate); AJCC TNM+S (the marker triad as the S axis - textbook-grade); IGCCCG risk for metastatic disease - THE TWO-PAPER SPLIT taught: the 2021 update is TWO separate JCO papers (seminoma PMID-verified 2,451-patient consortium; nonseminoma title-verified via PMC only - the single-citation habit is the documented trap; the 1997 original's PMID never matched - journal-cited)
meta.response: Marker normalization + imaging; post-chemotherapy residual-mass logic (NSGCT: resect residua >1cm - teratoma/viable fractions; seminoma: PET-directed - conventions textbook-grade, the SEMS PET substudy PMID-verified); GETUG-13's marker-DECLINE adaptation verified for poor-risk

Newly diagnosed.name: Surveillance-first, stage I seminoma (carboplatin x1 the randomized alternative)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: surveillance-preferred (NCCN secondhand; the alternatives' receipts verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized receipts verified (TE19 + mature); the tie is the teaching
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none on surveillance - which is the point; carboplatin x1 is a single day
Newly diagnosed.patient: For stage I seminoma: careful watching cures - nearly everyone survives on every road, so the plan minimizes treatment; one dose of carboplatin is the proven alternative for those who prefer acting once over watching.
drugs: Active surveillance (single-dose carboplatin AUC7 the alternative)

Newly diagnosed.name: Surveillance, stage I nonseminoma (BEP x1 for LVI+ - the SWENOTECA router)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: surveillance with risk-adapted BEP x1 (SWENOTECA verified; NCCN secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified program + mature receipts; the tie is the teaching
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none on surveillance; one BEP cycle's short ledger for LVI+
Newly diagnosed.patient: For stage I nonseminoma: watching cures here too - and if the tumor showed blood-vessel invasion, a single chemotherapy cycle cuts the relapse risk by ninety percent.

Newly diagnosed.name: BEP x3 (metastatic, IGCCCG good-risk)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention on a verified lineage; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: three intense weeks x3 - nausea, counts, and the bleomycin watch
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread disease in the good-risk group: three cycles of the chemotherapy that made this the most curable metastatic cancer in medicine.
drugs: Bleomycin + etoposide + cisplatin x3 (EP x4 alternative)

Newly diagnosed.name: BEP x4 + the decline watch (intermediate/poor-risk)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: BEP x4 with decline-adapted intensification (GETUG-13 verified)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: four full cycles (more if intensified) - the survivorship ledger's heaviest deposits
Newly diagnosed.patient: For higher-risk spread disease: four chemotherapy cycles - with the blood markers after cycle one deciding whether to intensify; most patients in even this group are cured.
drugs: BEP x4 (+/- decline-triggered intensification per GETUG-13)

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift - and in this disease, almost never the answer
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is always a real choice - though this is the cancer where curative treatment succeeds so reliably that the honest counsel almost always favors it.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Salvage chemotherapy: TIP or HDCT+rescue (the open question, held open)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: both roads legitimate; the randomized answer pending (TIGER - held open)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: verified receipts both roads; the equipoise itself is the verified state
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: TIP's heavy ledger or transplant-intensity - salvage cure is bought expensively
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: If this cancer relapses, it is still usually CURABLE - two proven salvage roads exist (standard-dose and high-dose with stem-cell support), and the trial comparing them head-to-head has finished enrolling but not yet reported.
drugs: TIP (paclitaxel/ifosfamide/cisplatin) OR high-dose carboplatin/etoposide + stem-cell rescue

Relapsed / recurrent.name: The surgical chapter (residua, late relapse, growing teratoma)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the residual/late-relapse conventions (textbook-grade, marked; PET substudy verified)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: major retroperitoneal surgery - the craft is nerve-sparing and completeness
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Some of this disease's cures are surgical: leftover masses after chemotherapy, returns years later, and the strange 'growing teratoma' all answer to an experienced surgeon rather than more chemotherapy.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice at every step - reached here only after the unusually deep bench of curative options.

refs.label: THE CISPLATIN REVOLUTION: Einhorn & Donohue, 'Cis-diamminedichloroplatinum, vinblastine, and bleomycin combination chemotherapy in disseminated testicular cancer' (Ann Intern Med 1977;87:293-8 - PMID 71004, pubmed-url-match): 74% CR + 26% PR in 47 evaluable; 85% disease-free after residual resection (verified snippet). THE CISPLATIN-FREE DECOYS documented: PMID 56214 (VAB - the pre-cisplatin predecessor) and 54212 (bleomycin/vinblastine) share the era and would be wrong receipts. BEP as PVB's refinement: convention-grade

IGCCCG with THE TWO-PAPER-SPLIT DISCIPLINE: the 2021 update is TWO JCO papers - SEMINOMA (Beyer, PMID 33729863, pubmed-url-match: 2,451 patients; LDH >2.5x ULN splits good-risk - verified snippet) and NONSEMINOMA (Gillessen - exact title matched via PMC ONLY; PMID 33822655 memory-grade); the 1997 ORIGINAL's PMID never matched (cited: JCO 1997;15:594-603). Decoys crowding the search documented (the 2006 meta-analysis; a 2025 survey). Citing 'the 2021 update' as one paper is the trap

TE19/MRC-EORTC stage I seminoma (Oliver, Lancet 2005 - PMID 16039331, pubmed-url-match): 1,477 patients - single-dose carboplatin AUC7 non-inferior to RT (verified); MATURE results matched (21282539): contralateral GCT 2 vs 15 favoring carboplatin (verified snippet). THE NEAR-TITLE DECOY documented: 16039313 ('Adjuvant carboplatin in stage I seminoma') sits one line away - different paper

SWENOTECA stage I NSGCT: the risk-adapted program (Tandstad, JCO 2009 - PMID 19307506, pubmed-url-match) + MATURE results (25114021, matched): single-cycle BEP for LVI+ cuts relapse ~90% (verified snippet) - the LVI router's randomized-program receipts

GETUG-13 (Fizazi, Lancet Oncol 2014 - PMID 25456363, pubmed-url-match): personalised chemotherapy by TUMOR-MARKER DECLINE in poor-prognosis GCT - unfavourable decliners benefit from intensification (verified) - a slope as a verified treatment router; favorable decliners stay the course

TIP salvage (Kondagunta/MSK, JCO 2005 - PMID 16170162, pubmed-url-match): paclitaxel/ifosfamide/cisplatin - TERMINOLOGY KEPT EXACT: the verified title says 'SECOND-LINE therapy' (= initial salvage; the briefing's 'first-line salvage' wording corrected to the paper's own); n=46; the 2024 long-term follow-up matched (39028926)

HIGH-DOSE CHEMOTHERAPY + STEM-CELL RESCUE (Einhorn, NEJM 2007 - PMID 17652649, pubmed-url-match): n=184, tandem carboplatin 700/etoposide 750 - ~40% durable remission in platinum-REFRACTORY disease (verified snippet; the overall ~63% figure memory-grade). THE CONTRAST verified: the negative FIRST-line HDCT randomized trial (17235042, matched) locates intensification's value in salvage, not up front

TIGER - THE OPEN QUESTION HELD OPEN (the stack's 13th premise correction, confirmed INDEPENDENTLY BY BOTH SWEEPS): design paper matched (21750688: TIP vs TI-CE first salvage, Alliance/EORTC); accrual CLOSED 2022-10-26 (n~420); NO readout found anywhere - five targeted searches, a 2025 systematic review and a 2024 HDCT analysis both state results 'pending.' The briefing's '~2025-26 readout' was UNSUPPORTED. Any spec/item claiming a TIGER result is AUTO-WRONG until registry/PubMed re-check

THE SEMINOMA-RPLND REFRAME (the stack's 14th premise correction): PRIMETEST (PMID 36372627, pubmed-url-match) was effectively NEGATIVE - 30% recurrence (95% CI 16-49), PRIMARY ENDPOINT NOT MET (verified snippet); SEMS's primary paper (JCO 2022) never PMID-matched (its PET-accuracy substudy 40203124 matched; adjacent results paper 37672753 matched); COTRIMS secondhand (~17.9% pooled relapse). Primary RPLND for CS IIA/B seminoma = guideline-listed but investigational-with-a-relapse-signal; the active follow-ons are CANADIAN/GERMAN - no US door. Post-chemo residual conventions (>1cm NSGCT; PET-directed seminoma) textbook-grade, marked

miR-371a-3p AT ITS EXACT STATUS: the M371 validation (Dieckmann, JCO 2019 - PMID 30875280, pubmed-url-match): sensitivity 90.1%, specificity 94.0%, AUC 0.966; NOT elevated in teratoma (verified snippet); SWOG S1823 CLOSED to accrual 2024-05 (interim ASCO 2026: specificity 94%, NPV 90, relapse HR 9.9 - secondhand); available in the US as a CAP/CLIA LDT at ONE center (UCSD, launched 2025-11); NOT FDA-approved/cleared; NO marker-ADAPTED treatment trial exists anywhere in the US (said). CLIMATE interim ex-US

THE DIE-OF-TREATMENT LEDGER: Travis second-malignancy receipt (JNCI 1997 - PMID 9326912, pubmed-url-match; the larger 2005 40,576-patient paper never matched - its 1.6-2.1x/1.5-4.4x figures memory-grade); cisplatin-era second-cancer continuation matched (31597192); the long-term morbidity review matched (26216826 - CVD/oto/neuro/hypogonadism/infertility). THE FUNG FLAGSHIP (JCO 2018 North American survivor assessment) never PMID-matched - name-cited only, its specifics memory-grade
Cryptorchidism meta-analysis (PMID 23423470, pubmed-url-match): RR 4.1 (95% CI 3.6-4.7), stronger for bilateral/ipsilateral/seminoma (verified snippet) - the risk-factor receipt

THE IO NULL (property-enforced - no checkpoint inhibitor carded): pembrolizumab in refractory GCT (GU14-206 lineage - PMID 29045540 via the trials sweep's sources): no responses - the class is null here; durvalumab-era attempts concordant; only tissue-agnostic edge cases (MSI-H/TMB-H) apply. E-VIRTUE's combination arm is an ADC trial, not an ICI resurrection

THE CONVENTIONS (textbook-grade, honestly marked - none PMID-anchored this sweep): markers BEFORE orchiectomy; INGUINAL approach never trans-scrotal (the violation convention); SPERM BANKING BEFORE therapy; the marker triad as the S-classification axis; the AFP rule (pure seminoma never makes AFP); post-chemo residua >1cm resected (three fractions); growing teratoma syndrome; late relapse >2yr surgery-first; nerve-sparing RPLND; i(12p) as the GCT genomic signature; young-men epi. Each carried as the convention it is

THE SHELF: TIGER atop everything (unresolved - LOUD); BNT211 CLDN6 CAR-T EUROPE-ONLY (Nature Med receipts; no US site - never a US door); seminoma-RPLND follow-ons ex-US (Canadian NCT06932458 - which appeared on a US-facing list, the FALSE-US-DOOR hazard documented; German PRIMETEST II NCT06144736; NCT05345158 country unresolved); P3BEP/AGCT1532 US-arm accrual UNVERIFIED (stale institutional pages); AGCT1531 accrual state flagged; S1823 closed; IU cabozantinib read out (CBR 43.2% - secondhand); ASPIRE (VTE) + MAGESTIC (diagnostics) + PRESERVE (surgical QoL, weakest-sourced) as minor doors; NO GCT approval 2024-2026 (a verified absence - the ASCO Post roundup contains none)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

Pedmark otoprotection randomization (NCT07218913, City of Hope + NCI): sodium thiosulfate added to cisplatin in stage II-III TGCT - OPENED 2026-02-19, est. completion 2031; recruiting state UNKNOWN - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. Pedmark's FDA approval is PEDIATRIC-only (this is the off-label adult test, said) - the die-of-treatment ledger's first prevention door

E-VIRTUE (NCT06041503, NCI/Apolo): phase 2 rare-GU basket - enfortumab vedotin +/- pembrolizumab, treatment-refractory TGCT a NAMED cohort (n~68, ORR primary) - RECRUITING per web (site list unverified) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. The ADC strategy after the ICI era's null

The Indiana maintenance pair: zanzalintinib + oral etoposide post-salvage-HDCT (NCT06937866 - RECRUITING per ASCO GU 2026 TPS; est. primary completion 2030) and the randomized maintenance-etoposide-vs-observation sibling (NCT04804007 - accrual state UNVERIFIED) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. THE CONVENTIONS ARE MARKED AS CONVENTIONS: the AFP rule, the S axis, the inguinal approach, the >1cm residual logic, late-relapse-surgery-first, and the freezer are textbook-grade and say so - none carries a fabricated…
